free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to the high-risk PI-RADS 5 lesion and the rapid PSA velocity of 3.98 ng/mL/yr. This finding, combined with the history of a prior positive biopsy (ISUP Grade Group 2), mandates re-evaluation to determine if the current findings necessitate a change in management. The high PI-RADS score and PSA dynamics are decisive factors overriding the prior positive result.
